name: ts-sudt
description: Lesson 09: Simple UDT (sUDT) type script in TypeScript via ckb-js-vm

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild --platform=neutral --minify --bundle --external:@ckb-js-std/bindings --target=es2022 src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js && offckb debugger --read-file dist/index.js --bin node_modules/ckb-testtool/src/unittest/defaultScript/ckb-js-vm -- -c dist/index.bc
scripts.start: offckb debugger --tx-file mock_tx.json --cell-index 0 --cell-type input --script-group-type type --read-file dist/index.bc --bin node_modules/ckb-testtool/src/unittest/defaultScript/ckb-js-vm -- -r
